apps.name: Bureau
apps.shortDescription: Sovereign Office Suite — Spreadsheet, Document, Diagram, miniPaint
apps.description:
# Bureau

**Your office suite. Your server. Your rules.**

Bureau is a self-hosted office suite — four isolated workspaces that replace Google Docs, Sheets, Diagrams, and Photoshop for teams that refuse to hand their work to someone else's cloud.

Every spreadsheet, every document, every diagram, every image lives in its own sealed container. Separate storage. Separate permissions. No container can see another unless you explicitly connect them. That's not a setting — that's the architecture.

## Four Tools. Four Workspaces. Zero Overlap.

### Spreadsheet

Real-time multi-user editing — every keystroke arrives instantly. Formulas, formatting, multiple worksheets, comments, merge cells, sorting, search, pagination. Import existing Excel files with styles intact. Export to XLSX, CSV, PDF, or JSON.

### Document

Conflict-free collaborative editing powered by Yjs CRDT. Two people editing the same paragraph at the same time? Both edits survive. No lockouts. No copy-of-copy-of-final-v2 chaos. Headings, lists, blockquotes, code blocks, tables, and sections.

### Diagram

The complete draw.io engine — not a simplified toy. Every stencil library, every shape, every connector. Flowcharts, UML, ER diagrams, BPMN, network topology, freeform drawing. Export to XML, PNG, SVG, PDF.

### miniPaint

Layers, filters, drawing tools, crop, resize, rotate — image editing without uploading your photos to someone else's server. Export to PNG, JPG, BMP, WebP.

## What Sets It Apart

- **Sealed containers** — A spreadsheet can't see a document. A vulnerability in one container cannot reach another. Physically isolated, not just permission-separated.
- **Snapshots everywhere** — Named version snapshots across all four tools. Save, browse, compare, restore. One click.
- **Real-time collaboration** — See who's connected, their role, and watch edits appear live. Presence indicators, connection status, automatic re-sync.
- **Server-enforced permissions** — Viewer, Commenter, Editor, Admin. Not client-side hints — the server rejects unauthorized requests.
- **Fully air-gapped** — Every font, icon, library, and stylesheet is bundled. Works with zero internet. No CDNs. No tracking. Nothing phones home.
- **No lock-in** — XLSX, CSV, PDF, JSON, HTML, PNG, SVG, XML. Standard formats. Leave whenever you want.

## Pricing

**Free.** Install it on your server and use it. No subscription, no usage fees, no limits.

apps.name: Instasys Mail
apps.shortDescription: Email system with mail server control
apps.description:
Instasys Mail is a native email client for [Sandstorm](https://sandstorm.io), built with Go and HTMX. It connects directly to Sandstorm's Cap'n Proto APIs — no HTTP bridge required.

## Features

- **Inbox & Folders** — View, organise, and search your email across custom folders
- **Compose & Reply** — Rich compose form with reply, reply-all, and forward support
- **Attachments** — Upload, download, and inline-view attachments
- **Drafts** — Auto-save and manually save drafts; resume editing anytime
- **Search** — Full-text search across all messages
- **Star & Organise** — Star important messages, move between folders, bulk delete
- **Real-time Updates** — WebSocket push for new mail notifications
- **Role-based Access** — Sandstorm sharing with viewer, editor, and admin roles
- **Lightweight** — Single static binary, SQLite storage, zero external dependencies

## How It Works

Each Sandstorm grain is an independent mailbox. Email arrives via Sandstorm's built-in SMTP gateway and is stored locally in SQLite. The UI is server-rendered HTML with HTMX for seamless partial updates — no JavaScript framework required.

## Technical Details

- **Backend:** Go with native Cap'n Proto RPC (no sandstorm-http-bridge)
- **Frontend:** Server-side HTML + HTMX + WebSocket
- **Storage:** SQLite with automatic migrations
- **Binary:** Statically linked, runs inside the Sandstorm grain sandbox

apps.name: MiniGit
apps.shortDescription: Lightweight Git hosting with web viewer
apps.description:
A simple wrapper around git-http-backend and GitWeb, providing an extremely lightweight way to host
a web-browsable Git repository.

You can connect through your Git client to pull or push, and you can connect through your web browser
to search file contents and explore revision history.

You can also push to a special branch named `public` in order to publish its
static contents at a public Pearl URL.
